narrative.details:
Your focused concentration has dwindled so soon? More research must be done!

Oh yes, the price remains the same, adventurer. Venture forth into the blasted lands and return to me with ten brains from the redstone and two vulture gizzards.
narrative.objectives: Bring ten Basilisk Brains and two Vulture Gizzards to Bloodmage Lynnore.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yes, yes, give me a moment and more of the compound will be ready for your consumption, adventurer.

Take it... and adventurer, do not attempt to consume these experimental concoctions in rapid succession. The results could be disastrous.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you returned with the requested organs?
